title: HelixCare (Healthcare) - Customer Case Study (Q4 2025)
author: Vanessa Ortiz
body:
## Summary
HelixCare is a healthcare technology company that builds patient support tooling for provider networks. This customer story summarizes how Redwood Inference supported consistent AI-assisted summarization and routing experiences for care coordinators.

**Customer:** HelixCare
**Industry segment:** Healthcare
**Asset type:** Case study
**Publication quarter:** Q4 2025

## Outcomes (high level)
- Reduced response time variance during peak hours
- Simpler internal rollout due to predictable operational controls
- Increased confidence expanding AI workflows across teams

## Seller notes
Position this story for buyers who prioritize reliability and enterprise readiness.
